about: The Aesthetic Computer piece API, read from the runtime. `path` is where it sits on the $api object a piece destructures in paint/act/sim. Signatures are the runtime's own.

entries.name: blend
entries.doc: Shortcuts l: graph.line, i: ink, Defaults

entries.name: page
entries.doc: Point subsequent drawing at another painting buffer; page(screen) comes back.
examples: disks/cal.mjs:34  ← / →            — page (month pages months; week pages weeks; day pages days)

entries.name: edit
entries.doc: Edit pixels by pasing a callback.

entries.name: ink
entries.signature: ink(r, g, b, a) | ink(gray, a) | ink("red") | ink([r, g, b]) | ink() (random)
entries.doc: Set the paint color for everything drawn next. Returns the API so calls chain: ink(255, 0, 0).line(0, 0, 10, 10).
examples: disks/$.mjs:168  ink([160, 160, 160]).write(compressedText, { x, y, size: scale });
disks/$.mjs:195  ink([160, 160, 160]).write(compressedText, { x: startX, y, size: scale });
disks/$.mjs:204  ink([160, 160, 160]).write(compressedText, { x: loopX, y, size: scale });

entries.name: ink2
entries.doc: Secondary color, used by gradient-aware primitives.

entries.name: wipe
entries.doc: Fill the whole screen with a color; the usual first line of paint().

entries.name: backgroundFill
entries.doc: Set background fill color for reframe operations (especially for KidLisp pieces)

entries.name: clear
entries.doc: Clear the buffer to transparent (unlike wipe, which paints a color).
examples: disks/doodle.mjs:53  clear(); // Always clear if the line is changing.
disks/oldwand.mjs:996  clear(color, segments, segmentMarkers, totalLength, remote = false) {

entries.name: copy
entries.signature: copy(destX, destY, srcX, srcY, src, alpha = 1.0)
examples: disks/oldpull.mjs:121  copy(x, y, selection.x + x, selection.y + y, sketch);

entries.name: paste
entries.signature: paste(from, destX = 0, destY = 0, scale = 1, blit = false)

entries.name: stamp
entries.doc: Similar to paste, but always draws from the center of x, y. Has partial support for {center, bottom}. 24.02.15.12.19
examples: disks/kokazo.mjs:243  stamp(ink, color, x, y, jx, jy, r);

entries.name: pixel
entries.signature: pixel(x, y, painting = { width, height, pixels })
entries.doc: Return a pixel from the main buffer or from a specified buffer.
examples: disks/colplay.mjs:100  const color = pixel(x, y, system.painting);

entries.name: plot
entries.doc: Where a pixel is a region in which we draw from the upper left corner. (2D)
examples: disks/jas.mjs:557  plot(ox + fx * scale, oy + fy * scale);

entries.name: flood
entries.doc: Fill pixels with a color using a flood fill technique.

entries.name: compositeLayers
entries.doc: GPU-accelerated multi-layer compositing

entries.name: batchedEffects
entries.doc: GPU-accelerated batched effects (zoom+scroll+contrast+brightness in one pass)

entries.name: point
entries.doc: Plots a single pixel within the panned coordinate space. Basically a wrapper over plot, which should ultimately be renamed to set? Accepts x, y or {x, y}

entries.name: line
entries.signature: line(x1, y1, x2, y2) | line({x, y}, {x, y}) | line(x1, y1, x2, y2, thickness)
entries.doc: Draw a 1px line between two points in the current ink.
examples: disks/ableton.mjs:124  line(x, y + v, x + 1, y + v);
disks/ableton.mjs:527  const blurbY = labelY + 12;       // label line (10 tall) + 2 gap
disks/ableton.mjs:528  const buttonsY = blurbY + 14;     // blurb line (10 tall) + 4 gap

entries.name: lineAngle
entries.doc: Draws a line from a point at a distance... with an angle in degrees.

entries.name: setBufferAlpha
entries.doc: Set the alpha of every non-transparent pixel in a buffer to a uniform value. Useful for per-stroke alpha — must be called after drawing on the buffer.

entries.name: pppline
entries.doc: Takes an array of pixel coords `{x, y}` and filters out L shapes. Note: It checks the previous, current, and next pixel and requires a minimum set of 3 before it removes anything. Draws a regular `line` if only two pixels are provided. Transcribed from: https://rickyhan.com/jekyll/update/2018/11/22/pixel-art-algorithm-pixel-perfect.html

entries.name: oval
entries.signature: oval(x0, y0, radiusX, radiusY, filled = false, thickness = 1, precision,)
examples: disks/flower-eater.mjs:255  oval(x, y + 2, rx, max(1, floor(rx * 0.3)), true);

entries.name: circle
entries.signature: circle(x0, y0, radius, filled = false, thickness, precision)

entries.name: pie
entries.signature: pie(x0, y0, radius, startAngle, endAngle, precision = 3)
entries.doc: Draw a filled pie slice / wedge (for pie charts, progress indicators, etc.) startAngle and endAngle are in radians, 0 = right, PI/2 = down, etc.

entries.name: tri
entries.signature: tri(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, mode = "fill")
entries.doc: Triangle from three points; mode "fill" or "outline".
examples: disks/blank.mjs:480  tri(proj[a][0], proj[a][1], proj[b][0], proj[b][1], proj[c][0], proj[c][1]);
disks/blank.mjs:481  tri(proj[a][0], proj[a][1], proj[c][0], proj[c][1], proj[d][0], proj[d][1]);
disks/blank.mjs:496  tri(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2);

entries.name: poly
entries.doc: Draws a series of 1px lines without overlapping / overdrawing points. TODO: Add closed mode? Example: ink(handPalette.w).poly([...w, w[0]]);

entries.name: box
entries.signature: box(x, y, size) | box(x, y, w, h) | box(x, y, w, h, mode) | box({x, y, w, h}, mode)
entries.doc: Rectangle. `mode` is "fill" (default), "outline", "inline", or "fill*center" / "outline*center" to draw from the center.
examples: disks/1v1.mjs:1490  box(x * squareSize, y * squareSize, squareSize, squareSize);
disks/1v1.mjs:1516  box(x * squareSize, y * squareSize, squareSize, squareSize);
disks/a-star.mjs:819  box(x * CELL_WIDTH, y * CELL_HEIGHT, CELL_WIDTH, CELL_HEIGHT);

entries.name: shape
entries.signature: shape(x1, y1, x2, y2, ...) | shape([[x, y], [x, y], ...], filled = true)
entries.doc: Rasterize a filled or outlined polygon from point pairs.

entries.name: grid
entries.signature: grid({ box: { x, y, w: cols, h: rows }, transform: { scale, angle, width: twidth, height: theight, anchor }, centers = [], }, buffer,)

entries.name: draw
entries.signature: draw(drawing, x, y, scale = 1, angle = 0, thickness = 1)
entries.doc: Draw a stored vector drawing (from `drawing`/store) at a position.
examples: disks/icon.mjs:6  - [] Use angle: `draw(drawing, x, y, scale = 1, angle = 0)`

entries.name: setShowClippedWireframes
entries.doc: Function to toggle wireframe rendering

entries.name: clearWireframeBuffer
entries.doc: Function to clear wireframe buffer (called at start of frame)

entries.name: drawBufferedWireframes
entries.doc: Function to draw all buffered wireframes (called at end of frame)

entries.name: getRenderStats
entries.doc: Function to get current render stats

entries.name: printLine
entries.signature: printLine(text, font, startX, startY, blockWidth = 6, scale = 1, xOffset = 0, thickness = 1, rotation = 0, fontMetadata = null, fallbackFont = null,)

entries.name: pan
examples: disks/clock.mjs:3757  const pan = 0;    // Centered pan (could be enhanced later)

entries.name: unpan
entries.doc: Undo pan(x, y).

entries.name: savepan
entries.doc: Save the local transform.

entries.name: loadpan
entries.doc: Restore it.

entries.name: mask
entries.doc: Clip drawing to a rectangle until unmask().
examples: disks/commits.mjs:326  mask({ x: 0, y: topMargin, width: w, height: chatHeight });

entries.name: unmask
entries.doc: Lift the clip set by mask().

entries.name: scroll
entries.doc: Scroll the entire pixel buffer by x and/or y pixels with wrapping
examples: disks/gulmo.mjs:36  let scroll = 0; // continuous forward scroll (fractional rows)
disks/mibo.mjs:54  let scrollPhase = 0; // accumulated depth-scroll (fly-forward), advances in onSim
disks/mugs.mjs:35  let scroll = 0; // Negative scroll (like colors.mjs)

entries.name: flip
entries.doc: Mirror the screen.

entries.name: spin
entries.doc: Each ring rotates by exactly 'steps' pixels, preserving all data

entries.name: sort
entries.doc: Pixel-sort the screen — a glitch effect.

entries.name: zoom
entries.doc: Zoom the entire pixel buffer with 1.0 as neutral (no change) level < 1.0 zooms out, level > 1.0 zooms in, level = 1.0 does nothing anchorX, anchorY: 0.0 = top/left, 0.5 = center, 1.0 = bottom/right Uses bilinear sampling with hard-edge thresholding for smooth scaling with crisp output

entries.name: suck
entries.doc: Radial displacement transformation with pixel-perfect nearest neighbor sampling Creates discrete, lossless pixel movement without blur or center holes

entries.name: blur
entries.doc: Efficient Gaussian blur using separable filtering with linear sampling optimization Creates smooth blur effect by applying horizontal then vertical Gaussian convolution

entries.name: sharpen
entries.doc: Apply sharpening filter to enhance edges and details strength: 0 = no sharpening, 1 = normal sharpening, >1 = aggressive sharpening

entries.name: invert
entries.doc: Invert every pixel's color.

entries.name: contrast
entries.doc: Adjust the contrast of the pixel buffer level: 1.0 = no change, >1.0 = more contrast, <1.0 = less contrast

entries.name: shear
entries.doc: KidPix-style shear function shearX: horizontal shear factor (positive = right lean, negative = left lean) shearY: vertical shear factor (positive = down lean, negative = up lean)

entries.name: resetScrollState
entries.doc: Reset scroll accumulators - called when pieces change

entries.name: pasteWithAlpha
entries.doc: 🎨 Alpha-blended paste for crossfade compositing

entries.name: kidlisp
entries.signature: kidlisp(x = 0, y = 0, width, height, source, options = {})
entries.doc: 🎯 Simplified KidLisp integration using global singleton instance
examples: disks/kidlisp-in-js.mjs:64  kidlisp(0, 0, hw, h, "(wipe green) (ink blue) (box 20 20 60 60)");

entries.name: synth
entries.signature: sound.synth({ tone = 440, type = "square", duration = 0.1, beats = undefined, attack = 0.01, decay = 0.9, volume, pan = 0, immediate = false, probe = null, generator = null, })
entries.doc: Play a synthesized tone. `tone` is Hz or a note name like "c4"; returns a voice with .kill() and .update().
examples: disks/1but.mjs:66  sound.synth({ type: "triangle", tone: 1047, attack: 0, decay: 0.1, duration: 0.1, volume: 0.25 });
disks/1but.mjs:67  sound.synth({ type: "triangle", tone: 1319, attack: 0.06, decay: 0.1, duration: 0.1, volume: 0.2 });

entries.name: play
entries.doc: Play a loaded sample or sfx by id.
examples: disks/1v1.mjs:695  bgmPlaying = sound.play(bgmSfx, { loop: true, volume: 0.4 });
disks/1v1.mjs:763  bgmPlaying = sound.play(bgmSfx, { loop: true, volume: 0.4 });

entries.name: Button
entries.signature: new ui.Button(x, y, w, h) | new ui.Button({ x, y, w, h })
entries.doc: A button. In paint: btn.paint((b) => { ink(b.down ? "yellow" : "gray").box(b.box) }). In act: btn.act(e, { push: () => {}, down: () => {}, up: () => {}, cancel: () => {} }). Pass pens() as the 3rd arg to act for multitouch. Rebuild buttons in `reframed`.
examples: disks/arena.mjs:3554  up: { btn: new ui.Button(moveX + btnSize + gap, moveY, btnSize, btnSize), key: "forward", label: "↑", isArrow: true },
disks/arena.mjs:3556  left: { btn: new ui.Button(moveX, moveY + btnSize + gap, btnSize, btnSize), key: "left", label: "←", isArrow: true },
disks/arena.mjs:3559  view: { btn: new ui.Button(actionX, actionY, btnSizeWide, btnSize), key: "view", label: "VIEW", color: [150, 110, 200], isView: true },

entries.name: TextButton
entries.signature: new ui.TextButton(text = "Button", pos = { x: 0, y: 0 }, typeface = TYPEFACE_UI, gap = null)
entries.doc: A labelled button sized to its text.
examples: disks/ads.mjs:35  chatBtn = new ui.TextButton("CHAT", { center: "x", y: Math.floor(screen.height * 0.55), screen });

entries.name: label
entries.doc: Take over the system's corner label — the only sanctioned way to draw in the top-left.

entries.name: write
entries.signature: write(text, { x, y, size, center: "x" | "xy" }) | write(text, x, y)
entries.doc: Draw text in the current ink. Chains from ink(): ink("white").write("hi", { x: 10, y: 40 }).
examples: disks/arena.mjs:2908  write(txt, { x: rX - txt.length * 4, y }, undefined, undefined, false, font);
disks/arena.mjs:2918  write(t, { x, y }, undefined, undefined, false, font);
disks/arena.mjs:3094  write(msg1, { x: Math.floor(screen.width / 2 - msg1.length * 2), y: bannerY }, undefined, undefined, false, "MatrixChunky8");

entries.name: randInt
entries.doc: Random integer in [0, n].

entries.name: randIntRange
entries.doc: Random integer in [low, high].

entries.name: lerp
entries.doc: Linear interpolation a→b by t.

entries.name: clamp
entries.doc: Clamp a value between min and max.

entries.name: dist
entries.doc: Distance between two points.
examples: disks/bubble.mjs:79  let distanceFromCenter = num.dist(pointer.x, pointer.y, centerX, centerY);
disks/bubble.mjs:290  let distanceFromCenter = num.dist(e.x, e.y, centerX, centerY);
disks/bubble.mjs:356  let distanceFromCenter = num.dist(e.x, e.y, centerX, centerY);

entries.name: map
entries.doc: Map a value from one range to another.

entries.name: radians
entries.doc: Degrees to radians.

entries.name: Box
entries.doc: An axis-aligned rectangle with .x .y .w .h and .contains({x, y}).

entries.name: Circle
entries.doc: A circle with .contains(point).
examples: disks/staka.mjs:53  ball.circle = new geo.Circle(screen.width / 2, screen.height / 2 - 100, radius);

entries.name: screen
entries.doc: The canvas. Read width/height in paint(); never write screen.pixels directly (writes can silently drop) — draw into your own painting buffer and paste() it.

entries.name: pen
entries.doc: The single primary pointer; null when there is none. Read in paint()/sim().

entries.name: pens
entries.doc: Every active pointer, for multitouch. Pass to btn.act(e, callbacks, pens()).

entries.name: event
entries.signature: e.is("touch") | e.is("draw") | e.is("lift") | e.is("keyboard:down:space") | e.is("reframed") ; e.x, e.y, e.delta, e.key
entries.doc: Events arrive in act({ event: e, ... }). Pointer: touch → draw → lift. Keys: keyboard:down:<key>, keyboard:up:<key>.

entries.name: sim
entries.signature: function sim({ ... }) — runs 120 times per second
entries.doc: Physics and timers go here, not in paint(); paint() runs at display rate and only when something needs painting.

entries.name: needsPaint
entries.doc: Ask for another paint() when the piece is static and something changed.

entries.name: painting
entries.doc: Make an offscreen buffer by drawing into it; show it later with paste(buffer, x, y).

entries.name: help.choose
entries.doc: Pick one item at random.

entries.name: help.repeat
entries.doc: Call a function n times.
